build.command: xcodebuild -project WBSandbox.xcodeproj -scheme WBSandbox -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath /tmp/wb-favourites-handoff-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

checks.name: feed
checks.coverage: new client, banking, frequency, limits; 242 combinations

checks.name: favourite amount
checks.coverage: prefill, disabled input, chips, decimals, bounds, original operation amount

checks.name: editing and undo
checks.coverage: order, expiry, duplicate undo, last item, monthly readings

checks.name: collection
checks.coverage: insertion/removal cascades, row insertion policy, delay cap, reverse wrap path

checks.name: deck
checks.coverage: inertia, cancellation, arm/disarm hysteresis, haptic gating

checks.name: reminder geometry
checks.coverage: fixed tail through scale, deformation, rotation and overshoot

checks.name: transaction amount
checks.coverage: decimal typing, trailing separator, formatting, limits, backspace

checks.name: documentation and motion reference
checks.coverage: nine consistent pages, relative links, media present, regenerated timeline samples match committed JSON

visual_review.method: iPhone 17 Simulator, current components, recorded intermediate frames
cases: deck demo through shared gesture model

media_note: GIF previews are 20 fps and loop for documentation; MP4 exports are 60 fps. Frame duplication cannot create missing captured detail. Clips retain the recorded motion tempo; tables and live timelines define implementation timing.
